lede: Wat Mae Wa Luang accounts for 19 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Lampang (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1906–1959 CE (9 of 19 carry a date).
